summaries.Romania: Romania narrowly escaped a credit downgrade to 'junk' status as S&P maintained its BBB- rating, but kept a negative outlook pending credible fiscal consolidation; meanwhile, political gridlock continues as President Nicușor Dan prepares his fourth premier nomination attempt.
summaries.Healthcare: The NIH is redesigning its public information portal for better accessibility, while addiction medication access for young people has improved but retention remains critically low; Congo's Ebola outbreak exceeds 4,000 deaths as it becomes the fastest-growing on record.
summaries.Tech: Apple is tightening macOS security controls against AI agents requesting full disk access, while iPhone 18 Pro Max users face persistent AT&T cellular issues requiring hardware replacement; Meta and OpenAI are racing to embed AI agents into consumer gadgets and enterprise software.

items.line: Romania's avoided junk status but faces critical pressure to deliver credible 2027-2028 fiscal plans or risk future downgrade.

items.title: Reacția ministrului Finanțelor după ce România a scăpat de retrogradarea în categoria junk: Prioritatea absolută este construirea unui buget credibil pentru 2027
items.snippet: Ministrul Finanțelor, Alexandru Nazare, a declarat vineri seară, după ce agenția de rating S&P a reconfirmat ratingul suveran al României la „BBB-”, cu perspectivă negativă, că ”prioritatea absolută este construirea unui buget credibil pentru 2027, bazat pe măsuri clare și sustenabile, care să conti
items.line: Finance minister confirms S&P decision hinged on fiscal discipline and EU fund absorption, with 2027 budget credibility now the absolute priority.

items.title: Access to addiction meds for young people has improved — but retention hasn’t
items.snippet: Only a small fraction of young people with opioid use disorder receive addiction medications, and few stay on them for long, a study finds.
items.line: Despite improved access to addiction medications for youth, retention rates remain concerningly low, limiting treatment effectiveness.

items.snippet:
Apple has confirmed an issue causing a “small number” of iPhone 18 Pro Max devices on AT&T to lose cellular service.

items.line: Apple confirms iPhone 18 Pro Max AT&T cellular service loss affects a small number of devices and requires hardware replacement, not software fix.

items.title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
items.snippet: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.
items.line: Apple is adding new macOS controls for Full Disk Access permissions to protect against increasingly capable AI agents requesting broad system access.

items.title: Principalele îngrijorări ale S&P privind România: blocajul politic, deficitul bugetar, datoria publică și riscul pierderii încrederii investitorilor
items.snippet: S&P Global Ratings a menținut ratingul României la BBB-, cu perspectivă negativă, dar avertizează că blocajul politic prelungit, incertitudinile privind bugetul pe 2027 și vulnerabilitățile externe pot pune în pericol consolidarea fiscală. Agenția estimează că economia României se va contracta cu 0,
items.line: S&P warns that prolonged political deadlock, 2027 budget uncertainty, and external vulnerabilities threaten Romania's hard-won fiscal stability.

items.title: Surse: Nicușor Dan are doi favoriți pentru funcția de premier. Planul președintelui pentru noul Guvern
items.snippet: Președintele Nicușor Dan va face a patra nominalizare de premier luni, după consultări cu partidele parlamentare. Surse politice au declarat pentru Digi24.ro că șeful statului are doi favoriți pentru funcția de prim-ministru: pe președintele PSD Sorin Grindeanu și pe ministrul interimar al Finanțelo
items.line: Nicușor Dan has two favored premier candidates lined up for Monday's fourth nomination round, signaling strategy shift after failed government.

items.title: An Ebola treatment center was burned down as the death toll in Congo passes 4,000
items.snippet: Congo's Ebola outbreak has killed more than 4,000 people, authorities said, as they struggle to contain what has become the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.
items.line: Congo's Ebola outbreak now exceeds 4,000 deaths and is the fastest-growing on record, compounded by treatment center arson undermining response.

items.title: STAT+: NIH awarded all its grant funding, but delayed and opaque decisions stymied researchers
items.snippet: The NIH continued reducing grants involving health disparities, race, and ethnicity but made little progress toward other administration priorities in the 2026 fiscal year.
items.line: NIH awarded all grant funding in 2026 but continued de-prioritizing health disparities research while maintaining opaque decision-making that delayed researcher feedback.

items.title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
items.snippet: Meta wants Muse in your TV and your toaster, so it's giving the code away for free.
items.line: Meta is open-sourcing Muse AI agent code to enable developers to embed it in consumer gadgets from TVs to appliances, accelerating AI proliferation.
